coverage.disclosure: Two distinct vault routes in one protocol (Centrifuge). This is not full token discovery and not a complete portfolio valuation.

positions.name: JTRSY / USDC Vault
positions.semantics: Official Centrifuge Pharos JTRSY vault. Wallet JTRSY shares are converted with convertToAssets at the pinned block.

positions.protocol: Third-party wrapper over a Centrifuge vault
positions.name: pNYLIM-HYB Third-party Wrapper
positions.semantics: Third-party ERC-4626-compatible pNYLIM-HYB wrapper. pRNH shares convert to USDC only after its code, asset, HYB backing, and official HYB/USDC base-vault relationship pass mandatory checks at the pinned block.
positions.provenance: The wrapper is not listed in Centrifuge's official deployment table. Its bytecode/interface, USDC asset, HYB backing, and the official base-vault HYB/USDC relationship are verified on-chain; ownership or official Centrifuge provenance is not claimed.

performance.disclosure: Vault share-value change over the observed period. Not wallet profit, not proof of ownership throughout the interval, not APR/APY, and not a guaranteed future rate.

accounting.rule: Wallet receipt-token balances are displayed, but USDC underlying exposure is counted once through each vault conversion.
